instruction: Navigate to the page that shows how to renew your driver's license

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from Virginia DMV homepage to the license renewal page. Uses the same evaluator pattern as original (URL regex match via accessibility tree). Similar complexity - requires 1-2 navigation clicks.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts active tab URL using active_url_from_accessTree getter
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match properly uses regex to verify URL matches expected license renewal page
Regex pattern ^https://(www\.)?dmv\.virginia\.gov/licenses-ids/license/renewing correctly identifies the target page
Complete coverage: instruction requires navigating to renewal page, evaluator verifies URL is on that page
Logic flow is sound: getter extracts current URL, metric compares against expected pattern, returns 1.0 for match
No postconfig needed as Chrome remains active after navigation
Pattern allows query parameters/fragments (no $ anchor), which is appropriate for web navigation tasks
